implementation_notes.note: Page follows a container/presenter pattern with colocalized tab components. Each tab is self-contained within tabs/ directory. Panels are self-contained within panels/ directory. Shared UI components and data loading are in @/lib and @/components.

Uses React hooks (useState) for local UI state (active tab, drilldown index, selected index). Uses React Query for server state (market data with automatic retry, refetch on focus, refetch on reconnect).

useMarketData hook loads from dataLoader (CloudFront-backed). Data flows down to tabs/panels via props. Click handlers bubble up to parent (MarketPerformance.tsx) which manages modals and drilldown state.

Uses TailwindCSS classes directly in JSX. Panel components from @/ui/components/panels provide standardized layout structure. PageHeaderCleanBadge provides consistent top header. Glassmorphism and gradient effects used in header variants.

Code includes commented-out imports for testing different PageHeader variants. Currently active: PageHeaderCleanBadge (clean bar with icon badge). Other options available: PageHeaderHeroBanner (full-width dramatic), PageHeaderPremiumCard (contained card), PageHeaderMinimalExpanded (horizontal massive scale), PageHeaderSplitDesign (icon left 1/3, content right 2/3).
DRILLDOWN_ENABLED_INDICES array in constants.ts controls which indices support drill-down feature (S&P 500, Dow Jones, Nasdaq, Russell 2000, Russell 1000).
